description: This Python source file provides functions for extracting, parsing, and summarizing text from various document formats including TXT, PDF, DOCX, and XLSX. It offers utilities for extracting raw text, inferring column types in spreadsheets, grouping headers by themes, generating schema summaries for large files, and slicing Excel rows into minimal text units for indexing.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Optional[str]] extract_text_from_bytes(filename: str, content: bytes)
methods.description: Extracts text from a file given its filename and byte content, supporting .txt, .pdf, .docx, and .xlsx formats.

methods.name: str _extract_txt(content: bytes)
methods.description: Decodes byte content as UTF-8 ignoring errors.

methods.name: str _extract_pdf(content: bytes)
methods.description: Extracts text from PDF content using pdfminer.six.

methods.name: str _extract_docx(content: bytes)
methods.description: Extracts text from DOCX content using python-docx, including paragraphs and table cells.

methods.name: str _extract_xlsx_text(content: bytes)
methods.description: Extracts textual content from XLSX files for small files; returns sheet summary for large files.

methods.name: str _infer_column_type(samples: List[Any])
methods.description: Guesses the data type of a column based on sample values, prioritizing null, boolean, number, datetime, or string.

methods.name: Dict[str,List[int]] _group_headers_by_theme(headers: List[str])
methods.description: Groups column headers by common themes using heuristics based on header naming conventions.

methods.name: List[List[int]] _fixed_size_column_groups(num_cols: int, group_size: int = 100)
methods.description: Divides columns into fixed-size groups for processing.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] build_xlsx_column_chunks_from_schema( schema: Dict[str, Any], group_size: int = 100, prefer_theme_groups: bool = True, )
methods.description: Generates column chunk groups based on schema, optionally grouped by theme or fixed size.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] iter_xlsx_row_slices( filename: str, content: bytes, per_row_max_cols: int = 200, group_size: int = 100, max_rows: Optional[int] = None, )
methods.description: Creates minimal textual slices of wide Excel rows, dividing into column groups for indexing.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Optional[Dict[str,Any]],Optional[str]] extract_xlsx_schema_or_text( filename: str, content: bytes, row_threshold: int = 100, col_threshold: int = 100, )
methods.description: Decides whether to read full text or produce a schema summary based on file size thresholds.

methods.name: str render_xlsx_column_chunk_text( filename: str, sheet: str, group_label: str, column_names: List[str], )
methods.description: Produces a concise textual description of a column chunk for embedding.

methods.name: str summarize_text_preview(text: str, max_chars: int = 500)
methods.description: Produces a short, single-line preview of extracted text for UI confirmation.
